job.title: Junior Frontend Engineer (Web Performance & SDK)
job.description: LogixTech (Delhi NCR) creates embeddable JavaScript analytics SDKs and client portals. We are seeking a Junior Frontend Engineer comfortable with browser APIs, script tag loaders, bundle budgeting, TypeScript, and cross-browser quirks.

pool.text: Browser APIs: proficient with MutationObserver, PerformanceObserver, and IntersectionObserver
TypeScript: authored zero-dependency TypeScript libraries compiled to UMD, ESM, and CJS targets
Rollup bundler: configured minification, dead code elimination, and bundle size limit checks
Cross-browser compatibility: tested behavior across Chrome, Safari, Firefox, and Edge browsers
TinyEventTracker: lightweight (2.4KB gzipped) embeddable client tracking snippet with queuing
B.Tech IT, Delhi Technological University (DTU), 2022–2026, CGPA 8.3/10
Web Security: handled Content Security Policy (CSP), CORS headers, and secure cookie flags
Ansible playbooks: automated Nginx configuration and SSL certificate renewals
Software Engineering Intern at WebMetric (Gurugram, 4 months): maintained customer script tester app
Git branching & semver: published versioned packages following semantic versioning guidelines
PostgreSQL indexing: created B-tree and GIN indexes for full-text search
HTML5 Canvas API: rendered client-side performance heatmaps
